name: Fluix
description:
Fluix turns the field data your teams already capture — inspections, work orders, sign-offs and forms — into answers you get by asking.

Built for operations, QHSE and field service teams running Fluix. Ask which documents are overdue and who owns them, what is still waiting on a signature, how a process is progressing, or what your teams submitted last month. Start broad, then refine: ask follow-up questions, reshape results into tables, and drill into anything that looks off, all in the same conversation.

The connector gives Claude three things: task report data (process and form views), document datasets (the structured fields captured in your completed forms), and document status across your workflows.

Works in Claude on the web, desktop, mobile, and in Claude Code.

Requirements and limitations. An active Fluix account is required, and you sign in on first use. The MCP Server feature must be enabled for your company's Fluix plan — it is not on by default; contact support@fluix.io to enable it. The connector is read-only: it never creates, edits, signs or deletes anything, and it returns only data your own Fluix permissions already allow. Dataset access additionally requires the Fluix data extraction feature, and document status requires a role with access to Document status.

New to Fluix? Get started at https://fluix.io/start-a-trial, find help at https://fluix.io/help, or contact us at https://fluix.io/contact-us or support@fluix.io.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fluix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fluix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fluix.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fluix MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fluix provides these MCP tools: docs_dataset_rows, docs_dataset_schema, docs_list_datasets, docs_status_rows, docs_status_schema, tasks_list_reports, tasks_report_rows, and tasks_report_schema.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fluix?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fluix in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Fluix requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fluix is developed by Fluix. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
